home.hero_title: SugarWise: Smart Diabetes Management for Children
home.hero_description: A revolutionary website and application designed to help diabetic patients, especially children, control blood sugar levels through intelligent monitoring and food intake calculation.
home.challenge_description: Managing diabetes in children requires constant vigilance, precise calculations, and emotional support. SugarWise addresses these challenges.
home.card1_description: Uncontrolled blood sugar levels can lead to dangerous diabetic comas, especially in children who may not recognize early symptoms.
home.card2_description: Determining insulin units based on food intake requires complicated math that can be overwhelming for families managing diabetes daily.
home.card3_description: Children with diabetes often feel different from their peers, leading to stress, anxiety, and challenges with adherence to treatment plans.
home.features_description: Our comprehensive platform combines monitoring, calculation, education, and support.
home.feature1_description: SugarWise connects with glucose monitors to provide real-time tracking. Receive instant alerts when readings are outside target ranges.
home.f1_bullet2: Historical data analysis to identify patterns
home.f1_bullet3: Share data securely with healthcare providers
home.feature2_description: Our advanced food database takes the guesswork out of insulin dosing. Simply input what your child eats, and SugarWise calculates the units.
home.f2_bullet1: Database of 10,000+ foods with carb counts
home.feature3_description: SugarWise turns diabetes education into fun, engaging games that help children understand their condition and feel empowered.
home.f3_bullet1: Interactive games about healthy food choices
home.impact_description: SugarWise is making a real difference in the lives of children with diabetes.
home.cta_description: Join thousands of families who have transformed their approach to diabetes management.
home.testimonials_description: Hear from parents and children who have experienced the SugarWise difference.
home.testi1_quote: SugarWise has completely transformed how we manage my daughter's diabetes. The food calculator takes away so much stress.
home.testi2_quote: The data sharing feature allows me to monitor my patients' glucose trends between visits and make more informed treatment decisions.
home.testi3_quote: I love the games on SugarWise! They make learning about diabetes fun. I earned enough points for a new game last month.

about.story_p1: SugarWise was born from a personal experience. Our founders, parents of children with Type 1 diabetes, struggled daily with the complexities of diabetes management. They saw firsthand how overwhelming it could be to balance glucose monitoring, food calculations, and insulin dosing while trying to give their children a normal childhood.
about.story_p2: Frustrated by the lack of comprehensive, child-friendly solutions, they assembled a team of doctors, engineers, and designers to create SugarWise - a platform that transforms diabetes management from a burden into an empowering experience for children and their families.

Compliance.HeroSubtitle: We adhere to the highest international standards to ensure your medical data is safe, legal, and secure.
Compliance.CommitmentDesc: SugarWise is dedicated to maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of all protected health information (PHI). We implement rigorous administrative, physical, and technical safeguards to comply with local and international healthcare regulations.
Compliance.HipaaDesc: We adhere to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) standards for protecting sensitive patient data.
Compliance.GdprDesc: For users within the EU and globally, we respect data sovereignty and the 'Right to be Forgotten' as mandated by the General Data Protection Regulation.
Compliance.Security1Desc: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256) to prevent unauthorized interception.
Compliance.Security2Desc: Role-based access control (RBAC) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) limit system access to authorized personnel only.
Compliance.Security3Desc: Automated daily backups and redundant server clusters ensure 99.9% uptime and data resilience.
Compliance.ReportDesc: If you believe you have discovered a security vulnerability or have a compliance-related question, please reach out to our dedicated compliance officer immediately.

CookiePolicy.HeroSubtitle: Transparency is key. We use cookies to improve your experience and keep SugarWise secure.
CookiePolicy.IntroDesc: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and to provide information to the owners of the site. At SugarWise, we use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences, and understand how you use our platform.
CookiePolicy.DescNecessary: Essential for the website to function. They allow you to log in, book appointments, and access secure areas. These cannot be switched off.
CookiePolicy.DescFunc: Allow us to remember choices you make (like your language or location) to provide a more personalized experience.
CookiePolicy.DescPerf: Help us understand how visitors interact with the website by collecting and reporting information anonymously (e.g., Google Analytics).
CookiePolicy.ManageDesc: You have the right to accept or reject cookies. You can modify your browser settings to decline cookies if you prefer. However, please note that disabling 'Strictly Necessary' cookies may prevent you from booking appointments or logging into your account.
CookiePolicy.PrefDesc: You can change your consent settings at any time by clicking the button below. This will reopen the cookie consent banner.
CookiePolicy.ContactPrompt: Questions about our Cookie Policy? Email us at

DataProtection.HeroSubtitle: Your health data is sensitive. Our infrastructure is built to protect it with military-grade security protocols.
DataProtection.SectionDesignDesc: SugarWise doesn't just add security as an afterthought. We follow the principle of 'Privacy by Design,' meaning data protection measures are embedded into the core architecture of our software development lifecycle and infrastructure.
DataProtection.CiaConfDesc: Strict access controls ensure that only you and your authorized healthcare providers can view your medical records.
DataProtection.CiaIntegDesc: We use hashing and version control to ensure your data remains accurate, complete, and unaltered during storage and transfer.
DataProtection.CiaAvailDesc: Redundant servers and automated backups ensure your health history is accessible whenever you need it, 24/7.
DataProtection.TechEncryptionDesc: All sensitive data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. Data in transit is protected via TLS 1.3 to prevent interception.
DataProtection.TechNetworkDesc: Our infrastructure sits behind advanced firewalls and Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS). We utilize Virtual Private Clouds (VPC) to isolate medical databases.
DataProtection.TechAuditDesc: Every access attempt to a medical record is logged. Our team utilizes automated tools to detect anomalous behavior in real-time.
DataProtection.Right1: Right to access your full medical history.
DataProtection.Right2: Right to rectify incorrect personal information.
DataProtection.Right3: Right to request data deletion (Right to be Forgotten).
DataProtection.Right4: Right to export your data (Data Portability).
DataProtection.BreachDesc: In the unlikely event of a data breach, we are committed to notifying all affected users within 72 hours.
DataProtection.BreachAlert: Transparency is our policy. We will never hide a security incident from our users.
DataProtection.DpoDesc: For specific inquiries regarding your data security, contact our DPO directly.

InjectionSites.PageSubtitle: A realistic medical model to help diabetic patients choose correct injection sites.
InjectionSites.SiteAbdomenDesc: The area surrounding the navel. Considered the fastest and most consistent absorption. Stay two fingers (5 cm) away from the navel.
InjectionSites.SiteAbdomenClinical: Best site for meal doses (Rapid-acting insulin).
InjectionSites.SiteThighsDesc: Upper outer part of the thigh (where muscle and fat exist). Avoid injecting into the inner thigh.
InjectionSites.SiteThighsClinical: Suitable for basal insulin (long-acting) before bedtime.
InjectionSites.SiteArmsDesc: The fatty area behind the triceps muscle. You may need assistance to reach it.
InjectionSites.SiteArmsClinical: Faster than thighs but slower than the abdomen.
InjectionSites.SiteButtocksDesc: The upper outer quadrant of the buttocks (wallet area). Contains the thickest layer of fat.
InjectionSites.SiteButtocksClinical: Excellent for long-acting insulin, and the least painful due to dense fat.
InjectionSites.SiteFingersDesc: Use the sides of the fingertip rather than the center pad to reduce pain and avoid calloused areas.
InjectionSites.SiteFingersClinical: Hands must be washed and dried thoroughly before pricking to ensure result accuracy.
InjectionSites.PromptTap: Click on colored areas to view medical details
InjectionSites.EmptyDesc: Click on any colored area of the body model to view absorption speed and approved clinical advice.
